summary: Ditch Plains is the clear winner today at chest-high prime S with light wind — the one drive worth making right now, with Matunuck a close second at 3ft glassy dawn. The home break at Rockaway is only a small clean dawn log, so unless you catch it early it's a travel day. From there it fades to short-period junk midweek, Thursday blows out onshore nearly everywhere, and the weekend is small but cleaner in the mornings — Friday's short-period bump is the next thing to watch.
